notes.title: Rolling Hamster's Gamepad Support Added
notes.content:
Howdy people!
We are pleased to announce the 1.1 update of Rolling Hamster.

CHANGES AND UPDATES

 Xbox controller and Playstation controller support.
 You can now  resize the game window.
 Overhaul of the UI to accommodate controller support and reworked the map selection menu for a smoother experience.

BUG FIXES

 Map selection is now fixed and there is no longer a significant slowdown when looking at the maps before a race.
 Engines are now silent when the game is paused and when the race is over.


Stay tune for futurs update!

notes.title: Rolling Hamster's first patch
notes.content:
Howdy people!
Rolling Hamster has been out for a little more than a week now, and we hope you like it so far! 
We were working on some patches for the game.
So, it's time for our first post on Steam ! 

We have a few things for you:

First let's tackle the content of the incoming patch

 The leaderboard now scrolls correctly!
 We changed the subheadtitle in the selection menu to be more clear about how to unselect an hamster


And with that, we also made a short video tutorial on how to use the new Remote play Together by Steam 
(which Rolling Hamster supports btw *wink wink*)
